text: From late November to Christmas Eve many towns put up a Weihnachtsmarkt: wooden stalls selling mulled wine (Glühwein), grilled sausage, gingerbread, roasted almonds and hand-made presents. Cambridge and many other British towns have German-style markets too.
Hot drinks are sold in a cup that carries a deposit (Pfand). When you bring the cup back, you get the money back, or you can keep the cup as a souvenir.
